items_flat.title_en: OpenAI shares ten advances on long-open math and CS problems solved by internal Astra model
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公布內部 Astra 模型解決十個長期未解數學與理論計算機問題的進展
items_flat.summary_en: On 1 August 2026 OpenAI published results from an internal version of its next major model Astra on ten problems that had seen no main-result progress for at least a decade. The results include new upper bounds on high-dimensional sphere packing approaching the Cohn–Elkies threshold, the first explicit construction of a non-sofic group, a disproof of Connes’s rigidity conjecture, resolutions of three Erdős problems, improved bounds on binary and spherical codes, new arithmetic-circuit lower bounds for the permanent, an exponential parallel-repetition theorem for two-player quantum games, polynomial-factor hardness for the closest-vector problem, and a determination of Ehrhart’s volume conjecture. All arguments were formalized into machine-checkable Lean 4 certificates released on GitHub; the estimated inference cost across the ten solutions is roughly $2,000 at Sol API rates.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月 1 日，OpenAI 公布其下一代主要模型 Astra 的內部版本，在十個至少十年無主要結果進展的開放問題上產出新成果。結果涵蓋高維球填充新上界、首個非 sofic 群明確構造、Connes 剛性猜想反證、三個 Erdős 問題的解決、二進制與球面碼改進界、永久元算術電路下界、雙人量子遊戲指數平行重複定理、最近向量問題多項式因子硬度，以及 Ehrhart 體積猜想的確定。所有論證均形式化為可機器檢查的 Lean 4 證明並公開於 GitHub；估計推理成本約 2,000 美元（以 Sol API 計價）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is one of the clearest public demonstrations yet that frontier models can generate novel, formalizable results on hard open problems at modest cost. It elevates questions of attribution, independent verification standards, and the evolving division of labour between AI systems and human mathematicians while Astra itself remains unreleased.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是目前最清晰的公開示範之一，顯示前沿模型能以適中成本產出可形式化的新數學結果。它提升了歸屬權、獨立驗證標準，以及 AI 與人類數學家之間分工演變的問題；Astra 本身仍未正式發布。
items_flat.quote: The results were achieved by an internal version of Astra, our next major model. Today, we are sharing a selection of ten results to problems that have been open and have seen no progress on the main result for at least a decade, and in most cases much longer.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這些結果由我們下一代主要模型 Astra 的內部版本達成。今天我們分享十個至少十年（多數更久）無主要結果進展的開放問題的成果。

items_flat.title_en: Minnesota AI nudification ban takes effect after judge denies xAI TRO
items_flat.title_zh: 明尼蘇達州 AI 裸化禁令在法官駁回 xAI 臨時限制令後生效
items_flat.summary_en: Minnesota’s first-in-the-nation law (HF 1606) banning AI tools that generate non-consensual intimate imagery of real people took effect on 1 August 2026 after U.S. District Judge Donovan Frank denied xAI’s request for a temporary restraining order. xAI had sued the state on First Amendment grounds shortly before the effective date; a hearing on a preliminary injunction is scheduled for 19 August. The law carries civil penalties of up to $500,000 per violation.
items_flat.summary_zh: 明尼蘇達州全美首例禁止生成真實人物非自願親密影像的 AI 工具法律（HF 1606）於 2026 年 8 月 1 日生效，此前美國地區法官 Donovan Frank 駁回 xAI 的臨時限制令申請。xAI 以第一修正案為由起訴該州；初步禁制令聽證會訂於 8 月 19 日。該法每次違規最高可處 50 萬美元民事罰則。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an early concrete test of state-level regulation of generative image models. It raises practical compliance questions for national platforms and leaves open whether the law will survive further constitutional challenge.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是州級監管生成影像模型的早期具體測試。它對全國性平台提出實際合規問題，並留下該法是否能通過進一步憲法挑戰的不確定性。
items_flat.quote: X.AI filed the motion on July 29, 2026, nearly three months after the law was signed, and only three days before the law is set to take effect. Such a delay in bringing the action and the motion suggests that harm is not immediate.
items_flat.quote_zh: X.AI 於 2026 年 7 月 29 日提出動議，距離法律簽署已近三個月，且僅在生效前三天。此延遲表明損害並非立即發生。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk claims Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 on speed and cost
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk 聲稱 Grok 4.5 在速度與成本上居 Pareto 第一
items_flat.summary_en: On 1 August 2026 Elon Musk posted that “Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 when considering speed & cost,” quoting independent testing that ranked it the best frontier model under those constraints. The claim accompanies ongoing public promotion of Grok’s efficiency relative to higher-priced peers.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月 1 日，Elon Musk 發文稱「考慮速度與成本時，Grok 4.5 是 Pareto 第一」，並引用獨立測試將其評為該限制下最佳前沿模型。此說法伴隨 xAI 持續公開推廣 Grok 相對於高價競品的效率優勢。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public Pareto claims keep competitive pressure on pricing and latency benchmarks, but independent third-party verification of the exact trade-off surface remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開的 Pareto 宣稱持續對定價與延遲基準構成競爭壓力，但精確權衡曲面的獨立第三方驗證仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 when considering speed & cost
items_flat.quote_zh: 考慮速度與成本時，Grok 4.5 是 Pareto 第一

brief_en: OpenAI detailed ten novel results on decade-old open math/CS problems produced by its internal Astra model, with public Lean proofs. Minnesota’s AI nudification ban took effect after a judge denied xAI’s TRO. Musk claimed Grok 4.5 is Pareto-optimal on speed and cost. No new model releases.
brief_zh: OpenAI 公布內部 Astra 模型在十個至少十年無進展的數學與理論計算機問題上產出新結果並公開 Lean 證明。明尼蘇達 AI 裸化禁令在法官駁回 xAI 臨時限制令後生效。Musk 聲稱 Grok 4.5 在速度與成本上居 Pareto 前沿。今日無新模型正式發布。
